### Register

Creates a new user account on the **rentNest** platform. Both tenants and landlords can register through this endpoint. (Admin accounts cannot be registered via this endpoint).

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/auth/register`
    

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | ✅ | Full name of the user |
| `email` | string | ✅ | Unique valid email address |
| `password` | string | ✅ | Account password (hashed by server) |
| `role` | string | ✅ | User role: `TENANT` or `LANDLORD` (case-insensitive, normalized to uppercase) |
| `phone` | string | ❌ | Contact phone number (defaults to `"Phone not provided"`) |
| `image` | string | ❌ | Profile image URL (defaults to `"Image not provided"`) |
| `bio` | string | ❌ | User biography (defaults to `"Bio not provided"`) |

#### Authentication

No authentication required. This is a public endpoint.

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | User registered successfully. Returns the created user object (without token or password hash). |
| **`400 Bad Request`** | Missing required fields, invalid role provided (e.g. attempting to register as `ADMIN`), or malformed body. |
| **`409 Conflict`** | A user with the provided email already exists. |

#### Example Response (`200 OK`)

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": "c1f7b3e0-8a21-4f9d-b712-3456789abcde",
    "name": "Amina Rahman",
    "email": "amina@example.com",
    "image": "Image not provided",
    "bio": "Bio not provided",
    "phone": "+8801700000000",
    "role": "TENANT",
    "activeStatus": "ACTIVE",
    "createdAt": "2026-08-26T09:44:30.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-08-26T09:44:30.000Z"
  }
}

 ```

## Login User

Authenticates an existing user and returns a **Bearer token** to be used in subsequent authenticated requests.

**Method:** `POST`  
**URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/auth/login`

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string | ✅ | Registered email address |
| `password` | string | ✅ | Account password |

### Authentication

No authentication required. This is a public endpoint.

---

### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200 OK` | Login successful. Returns a JWT Bearer token and user profile. |
| `400 Bad Request` | Missing email or password. |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Invalid credentials. |

> **Note:** Copy the returned `token` and set it as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header for all protected endpoints.

## Get Me

Returns the profile information of the **currently authenticated user** based on the provided Bearer token.

**Method:** `GET`
**URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/auth/me`

---

### Authentication

🔒 **Required** — Bearer token must be included in the `Authorization` header.

```
Authorization: Bearer <your_token>
```

---

### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `200 OK` | Returns the authenticated user's profile (id, name, email, role, etc.). |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Missing or invalid Bearer token. |

> Use this endpoint to verify the current session or retrieve user details after login.

**Create New Property**

Allows an authenticated landlord to list a new rental property on the **rentNest** platform. A category is created automatically alongside the property listing. Landlords do not provide `availability` in the request body; property availability defaults to `AVAILABLE` automatically upon creation.

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/landlord/properties`
    

#### Authentication

🔒 **Required** — Bearer token of a `LANDLORD` account must be included in the `Authorization` header (or as an `accessToken` cookie).

``` http
Authorization: Bearer <landlord_token>

 ```

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pName` | string | ✅ | Property name / title |
| `pLocation` | string | ✅ | Property location or address |
| `pPrice` | number | ✅ | Rental price (in BDT) |
| `pDescription` | string | ✅ | Full property description |
| `type` | string | ✅ | Property type enum: `APARTMENT`, `HOUSE`, `STUDIO`, `OFFICE`, `SHOP`, `WAREHOUSE`, `LAND`, `OTHER` (case-insensitive) |
| `pImage` | string | ❌ | Property image URL (defaults to `"Image not provided"`) |
| `description` | string | ❌ | Category description (defaults to `"Description not provided"`) |

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | Property created successfully. Returns the new property object and nested category. |
| **`400 Bad Request`** | Missing required fields (`pName`, `pLocation`, `pPrice`, `pDescription`, `type`) or invalid `type` value. |
| **`401 Unauthorized`** | Missing or invalid Bearer token / login session. |
| **`403 Forbidden`** | Authenticated user is not a landlord (or account is blocked). |

**Update Property**

Allows an authenticated landlord to update details of a property they own. Any omitted fields retain their existing values.

- **Method:** `PUT`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/landlord/properties/:id`
    

#### Authentication

🔒 **Required** — Bearer token of the property-owning `LANDLORD` must be included in the `Authorization` header (or as an `accessToken` cookie).

``` http
Authorization: Bearer <landlord_token>

 ```

#### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (UUID) | ✅ | The unique ID of the property to update |

#### Request Body

Provide any subset of the fields you wish to update:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pName` | string | Updated property title |
| `pLocation` | string | Updated location or address |
| `pPrice` | number | Updated monthly rental price (in BDT) |
| `pDescription` | string | Updated property description |
| `type` | string | Updated category type enum: `APARTMENT`, `HOUSE`, `STUDIO`, `OFFICE`, `SHOP`, `WAREHOUSE`, `LAND`, `OTHER` |
| `pImage` | string | Updated property image URL |
| `description` | string | Updated category description |

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | Property updated successfully. Returns the updated property object and category. |
| **`400 Bad Request`** | Empty request body or missing property ID path parameter. |
| **`401 Unauthorized`** | Missing or invalid Bearer token / login session. |
| **`403 Forbidden`** | Authenticated landlord does not own this property. |
| **`404 Not Found`** | Property with the given ID does not exist. |

**Delete Property**

Allows an authenticated landlord to permanently delete a property listing that they own. Associated category, rental requests, and reviews are removed per database cascade relations.

- **Method:** `DELETE`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/landlord/properties/:id`
    

#### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (UUID) | ✅ | The unique ID of the property to delete |

#### Request Body

None.

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | Property deleted successfully. |
| **`400 Bad Request`** | Missing property ID path parameter. |
| **`401 Unauthorized`** | Missing or invalid Bearer token / login session. |
| **`403 Forbidden`** | Authenticated landlord does not own this property. |
| **`404 Not Found`** | Property with the given ID does not exist. |

> \[!WARNING\]  
This action is irreversible. Associated category, rental request, and review records will be removed automatically via database cascade constraints.

---

### Get All Rental Requests (Landlord)

Retrieves all rental requests submitted across all properties owned by the authenticated landlord.

- **Method:** `GET`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/landlord/properties/requests` (or `http://localhost:5000/api/landlord/requests`)
    

#### Query Parameters

None. The endpoint automatically fetches all rental requests for all properties owned by the logged-in landlord.

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | Rental requests fetched successfully. Returns an array of rental request objects. |
| **`401 Unauthorized`** | Missing or invalid Bearer token / login session. |
| **`403 Forbidden`** | Authenticated user is not a landlord (or account is blocked). |

#### Example Response (`200 OK`)

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Rental requests fetched successfully",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "request-uuid-1",
      "propertyId": "property-uuid-1",
      "tenantId": "tenant-uuid-1",
      "message": "I would like to rent this property from next month.",
      "status": "PENDING",
      "createdAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

## Approve or Reject Rental Request

Allows an authenticated **landlord** to approve or reject a tenant's rental request for one of their properties.

**Method:** `PATCH`  
**URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/landlord/requests/:requestId`

---

### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `requestId` | string (UUID) | ✅ | The unique ID of the rental request to act upon |

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | string | ✅ | New status for the request: `approved` or `rejected` |
| `message` | string | ❌ | Optional message to the tenant explaining the decision |

---

### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200 OK` | Request status updated successfully. Returns the updated rental request. |
| `400 Bad Request` | Invalid status value provided. |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Missing or invalid Bearer token. |
| `403 Forbidden` | Landlord does not own the property associated with this request. |
| `404 Not Found` | Rental request with the given ID does not exist. |

**Get Property Details by ID**

Retrieves the full details of a specific rental property by its unique ID, including its availability status and category details.

- **Method:** `GET`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/properties/:id`
    

#### Authentication

🔓 **Not required** — This is a public endpoint.

#### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (UUID) | ✅ | The unique ID of the property to retrieve |

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | Property fetched successfully. Returns the full property object and nested category. |
| **`400 Bad Request`** | Missing property ID parameter in URL path. |
| **`404 Not Found`** | Property with the given ID does not exist. |

#### Example Response (`200 OK`)

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Property fetched successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": "e4b2a8d1-5f33-4c91-b8d9-123456789abc",
    "landLordId": "user-uuid",
    "pName": "Lakeview Apartment",
    "availability": "AVAILABLE",
    "pLocation": "Gulshan, Dhaka",
    "pPrice": "25000.00",
    "pDescription": "A furnished two-bedroom apartment near Gulshan Lake.",
    "pImage": "https://example.com/lakeview.jpg",
    "createdAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z",
    "category": {
      "id": "category-uuid",
      "type": "APARTMENT",
      "description": "Residential two-bedroom apartment",
      "propertyId": "e4b2a8d1-5f33-4c91-b8d9-123456789abc",
      "createdAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z"
    }
  }
}

 ```

### Get All Properties

Retrieves a list of properties. Supports optional filtering by location, exact price, and property type.

- **Method:** `GET`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/properties`
    

#### Authentication

🔓 **Not required** — This is a public endpoint.

#### Query Parameters (Optional)

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `location` | string | Case-insensitive partial match against property location (`pLocation`) |
| `price` | number | Exact rental price match (`pPrice`) |
| `type` | string | Category type filter: `APARTMENT`, `HOUSE`, `STUDIO`, `OFFICE`, `SHOP`, `WAREHOUSE`, `LAND`, `OTHER` (case-insensitive) |

_Example Query URLs:_

``` text
GET /api/properties
GET /api/properties?location=dhaka
GET /api/properties?price=25000&type=APARTMENT

 ```

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | Properties fetched successfully. Returns an array of property summary objects containing `id`, `availability`, `pName`, `pLocation`, `pPrice`, `category` (`id`, `type`), and `createdAt`. |
| **`404 Not Found`** | No properties found matching the supplied query filters. |

#### Example Response (`200 OK`)

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Properties fetched successfully",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "e4b2a8d1-5f33-4c91-b8d9-123456789abc",
      "availability": "AVAILABLE",
      "pName": "Lakeview Apartment",
      "pLocation": "Gulshan, Dhaka",
      "pPrice": "25000.00",
      "category": {
        "id": "category-uuid",
        "type": "APARTMENT"
      },
      "createdAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

## Get Categories

Retrieves all property categories available on the rentNest platform. Categories are used to classify properties (e.g., apartment, house, studio, villa).

**Method:** `GET`
**URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/categories`

---

### Authentication

🔓 **Not required.** This is a public endpoint.

---

### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `200 OK` | Returns an array of category objects, each containing an `id` and `name`. |

> Use the returned category `id` values when creating or filtering properties.

### Create New Rental Request

Allows an authenticated tenant to submit a rental request for an available property listed on **rentNest**. Requests can only be submitted for properties with `availability: AVAILABLE`. New requests start with a default status of `PENDING`.

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/rentals`
    

#### Authentication

🔒 **Required** — Bearer token of a `TENANT` account must be included in the `Authorization` header (or as an `accessToken` cookie).

``` http
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_token>

 ```

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `propertyId` | string (UUID) | ✅ | The ID of the property the tenant wants to rent |
| `message` | string | ❌ | Message to the landlord (defaults to `"No message left by tenant"`) |

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | Rental request created successfully. Returns the new rental request object with status `PENDING`. |
| **`400 Bad Request`** | Missing required field (`propertyId`), or the property is not available for rent (`Property is not available for rent`). |
| **`401 Unauthorized`** | Missing or invalid Bearer token / login session. |
| **`403 Forbidden`** | Authenticated user is not authorized or account is blocked. |
| **`404 Not Found`** | Property with the given `propertyId` does not exist. |

#### Example Response (`200 OK`)

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Rental request created successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": "rental-request-uuid",
    "propertyId": "property-uuid",
    "tenantId": "tenant-uuid",
    "message": "I would like to rent this property from next month.",
    "status": "PENDING",
    "createdAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z"
  }
}

 ```

### Get All Rental Requests (Tenant)

Retrieves all rental requests submitted by the currently authenticated tenant, ordered newest first.

- **Method:** `GET`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/rentals`
    

#### Authentication

🔒 **Required** — Bearer token of a `TENANT` account must be included in the `Authorization` header (or as an `accessToken` cookie).

``` http
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_token>

 ```

#### Query Parameters

None. The endpoint fetches all rental requests belonging to the logged-in tenant.

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | Rental requests fetched successfully. Returns an array of rental request objects containing `id`, `propertyId`, `tenantId`, `status`, and `createdAt`. |
| **`401 Unauthorized`** | Missing or invalid Bearer token / login session. |
| **`404 Not Found`** | Tenant has not submitted any rental requests (`No rental requests found for this user`). |

#### Example Response (`200 OK`)

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Rental requests fetched successfully",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "rental-request-uuid",
      "propertyId": "property-uuid",
      "tenantId": "tenant-uuid",
      "status": "PENDING",
      "createdAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

### Get Rental Details

Retrieves full details of a specific rental request owned by the authenticated tenant, including summary info of the associated property.

- **Method:** `GET`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/rentals/:id`
    

#### Authentication

🔒 **Required** — Bearer token of the `TENANT` who created the request must be included in the `Authorization` header (or as an `accessToken` cookie).

``` http
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_token>

 ```

#### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (UUID) | ✅ | The unique ID of the rental request to retrieve |

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | Rental request fetched successfully. Returns the rental request object along with nested property details. |
| **`400 Bad Request`** | Missing rental request ID in URL path. |
| **`401 Unauthorized`** | Missing or invalid Bearer token / login session. |
| **`403 Forbidden`** | Authenticated user is not the tenant who submitted this rental request. |
| **`404 Not Found`** | Rental request with the given ID does not exist. |

#### Example Response (`200 OK`)

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Rental request fetched successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": "rental-request-uuid",
    "propertyId": "property-uuid",
    "tenantId": "tenant-uuid",
    "message": "I would like to rent this property from next month.",
    "status": "PENDING",
    "createdAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z",
    "property": {
      "id": "property-uuid",
      "pName": "Lakeview Apartment",
      "pLocation": "Gulshan, Dhaka",
      "pPrice": "25000.00",
      "pDescription": "A furnished two-bedroom apartment near Gulshan Lake."
    }
  }
}

 ```

### Create Payment Session

Initiates a Stripe-hosted Checkout session for an approved rental request owned by the authenticated tenant. The API returns a `paymentUrl` to redirect the tenant to Stripe Checkout.

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/payments/create`
    

#### Authentication

🔒 **Required** — Bearer token of a `TENANT` account must be included in the `Authorization` header (or as an `accessToken` cookie).

``` http
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_token>

 ```

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rentalRequestId` | string (UUID) | ✅ | The unique ID of an approved rental request owned by the current tenant |

``` json
{
  "rentalRequestId": "71991bba-752e-4b79-b92a-331730b3b76e"
}

 ```

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | Payment session created successfully. Returns the Stripe Checkout URL. |
| **`400 Bad Request`** | Missing `rentalRequestId` field in the request body. |
| **`401 Unauthorized`** | Missing or invalid Bearer token / login session. |
| **`403 Forbidden`** | Tenant does not own this rental request, OR the rental request status is not `APPROVED`. |
| **`404 Not Found`** | Rental request with the given ID does not exist. |

#### Example Response (`200 OK`)

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Payment session created successfully",
  "data": {
    "paymentUrl": "https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_a1b2c3d4e5f6..."
  }
}

 ```

### Get Payment History

Retrieves the complete payment history for the currently authenticated user, ordered newest first.

- **Method:** `GET`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/payments`
    

#### Authentication

🔒 **Required** — Bearer token of an authenticated user (`TENANT` or `LANDLORD`) must be included in the `Authorization` header (or as an `accessToken` cookie).

``` http
Authorization: Bearer <your_token_here>

 ```

#### Query Parameters / Request Body

None.

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | Payment history fetched successfully. Returns an array of payment transaction objects. |
| **`401 Unauthorized`** | Missing or invalid Bearer token / login session. |
| **`404 Not Found`** | No payment history found for the authenticated user (`No payment history found for this user`). |

#### Payment Record Object Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (UUID) | Unique identifier of the payment record |
| `userId` | string (UUID) | UUID of the user who completed the payment |
| `amount` | Decimal / number | Payment amount |
| `status` | string | Payment status enum: `PENDING`, `COMPLETED`, `FAILED` |
| `createdAt` | string (ISO 8601) | Timestamp when the payment was created |

#### Example Response (`200 OK`)

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Payment history fetched successfully",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "9401e294-9da2-4175-b655-759cc5b5850f",
      "userId": "d00372ba-8ba2-48be-9e69-6d82e70577ee",
      "amount": "25000.00",
      "status": "COMPLETED",
      "createdAt": "2026-08-26T03:39:05.519Z"
    },
    {
      "id": "72267002-89dc-45f6-aa60-19c1154a345f",
      "userId": "d00372ba-8ba2-48be-9e69-6d82e70577ee",
      "amount": "18000.00",
      "status": "COMPLETED",
      "createdAt": "2026-08-25T20:24:56.348Z"
    }
  ]
}

 ```

## Get Payment Details

Retrieves the full details of a specific payment transaction by its unique payment ID. This endpoint is useful for tracking payment status, verifying Stripe transaction references, and viewing associated user and rental request information.

---

### Endpoint

```
GET /api/payments/:paymentId
```

---

### URL Path Parameter

| Parameter   | Type   | Required | Description                                      |
|-------------|--------|----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `paymentId` | UUID   | ✅ Yes   | The unique identifier of the payment to retrieve. |

**Example:**
```
GET /api/payments/9401e294-9da2-4175-b655-759cc5b5850f
```

---

### Authentication

> 🔒 **Authentication required.** This endpoint is protected and requires a valid Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Only authorized users (e.g., the tenant who made the payment or an admin) should be able to access payment details.

```
Authorization: Bearer <your_token>
```

---

### Response

**Status:** `200 OK`

Returns a payment object with full details including the associated user and rental request.

#### Response Fields

| Field               | Type     | Description                                                  |
|---------------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| `id`                | UUID     | Unique identifier of the payment.                            |
| `userId`            | UUID     | ID of the user (tenant) who made the payment.                |
| `rentalRequestId`   | UUID     | ID of the rental request linked to this payment.             |
| `status`            | String   | Payment status (e.g., `COMPLETED`, `PENDING`, `FAILED`).     |
| `stripeCustomerId`  | String   | Stripe customer ID associated with the transaction.          |
| `stripePaymentId`   | String   | Stripe payment intent ID for the transaction.                |
| `amount`            | Number   | Payment amount (in the platform's base currency unit).       |
| `createdAt`         | DateTime | Timestamp when the payment record was created.               |
| `updatedAt`         | DateTime | Timestamp when the payment record was last updated.          |
| `user`              | Object   | Nested user object with `id`, `name`, `email`, and `role`.   |
| `rentalRequest`     | Object   | Nested rental request with `id`, `status`, and `property`.  |

#### Nested `user` Object

| Field   | Type   | Description                          |
|---------|--------|--------------------------------------|
| `id`    | UUID   | User's unique ID.                    |
| `name`  | String | User's display name.                 |
| `email` | String | User's email address.                |
| `role`  | String | User's role (e.g., `TENANT`).        |

#### Nested `rentalRequest` Object

| Field      | Type   | Description                                          |
|------------|--------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `id`       | UUID   | Rental request's unique ID.                          |
| `status`   | String | Status of the rental request (e.g., `APPROVED`).    |
| `property` | Object | Property details: `id`, `pName`, `pLocation`, `pPrice`. |

#### Example Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Payment details fetched successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": "9401e294-9da2-4175-b655-759cc5b5850f",
    "userId": "d00372ba-8ba2-48be-9e69-6d82e70577ee",
    "rentalRequestId": "71991bba-752e-4b79-b92a-331730b3b76e",
    "status": "COMPLETED",
```

### Create Review

Allows an authenticated tenant to submit a review for a completed, paid rental request. The review is automatically linked to the associated property.

- **Method:** `POST`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/reviews`
    

#### Authentication

🔒 **Required** — Bearer token of a `TENANT` account must be included in the `Authorization` header (or as an `accessToken` cookie).

``` http
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_token>

 ```

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rentalRequestId` | string (UUID) | ✅ | The unique ID of the rental request paid by the tenant |
| `title` | string | ✅ | Short title for the review |
| `description` | string | ✅ | Review content or feedback |

``` json
{
  "rentalRequestId": "rental-request-uuid",
  "title": "Excellent location",
  "description": "The property was clean, well maintained, and exactly as described."
}

 ```

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | Review created successfully. Returns the new review object. |
| **`400 Bad Request`** | Payment for the rental request is not completed, or tenant has already created a review for this request (`You have already created a review for this rental request`). |
| **`401 Unauthorized`** | Missing or invalid Bearer token / login session. |
| **`403 Forbidden`** | Authenticated user did not make the payment for this rental request (`You are not authorized to create review for this rental request`). |
| **`404 Not Found`** | Payment record not found for the supplied `rentalRequestId`. |

#### Example Response (`200 OK`)

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Review created successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": "review-uuid",
    "tenantId": "tenant-uuid",
    "propertyId": "property-uuid",
    "rentalRequestId": "rental-request-uuid",
    "title": "Excellent location",
    "description": "The property was clean, well maintained, and exactly as described.",
    "createdAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z"
  }
}

 ```

### Update User Active Status (Admin)

Admin-only endpoint to update a user's account status (`ACTIVE` or `BLOCKED`) by their user ID. A blocked user cannot log in or access protected platform resources.

- **Method:** `PATCH`
    
- **URL:** `http://localhost:5000/api/admin/users/:id`
    

#### Authentication

🔒 **Required** — Bearer token of an `ADMIN` account must be included in the `Authorization` header (or as an `accessToken` cookie).

``` http
Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>

 ```

#### Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (UUID) | ✅ | The unique ID of the user whose status is being updated |

#### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | string | ✅ | Account status enum: `ACTIVE` or `BLOCKED` |

``` json
{
  "status": "BLOCKED"
}

 ```

#### Expected Response

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **`200 OK`** | User status updated successfully. Returns the updated user object. |
| **`400 Bad Request`** | Missing required `status` field or missing user ID parameter. |
| **`401 Unauthorized`** | Missing or invalid Bearer token / login session. |
| **`403 Forbidden`** | Authenticated user is not an administrator. |
| **`404 Not Found`** | User with the given ID does not exist in the database. |

> \[!WARNING\]  
Blocking a user (`status: "BLOCKED"`) prevents them from logging in or using protected API endpoints. 
  

#### Example Response (`200 OK`)

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "message": "User status updated successfully",
  "data": {
    "id": "user-uuid-1",
    "name": "Amina Rahman",
    "email": "amina@example.com",
    "role": "TENANT",
    "activeStatus": "BLOCKED",
    "createdAt": "2026-08-26T09:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-08-26T11:44:00.000Z"
  }
}

 ```
